letters.subject: Final notice: invoice SI-30318, 83 days overdue
letters.body:
Hello Daniel,

Our records show that invoice SI-30318 for £6,480.00 was due on 14 August 2026 and is now 83 days overdue. Invoice SI-30349 for £5,940.00 was due on 11 September 2026 and is 55 days overdue.

This is our final notice. Please arrange payment of both invoices within 7 days of this email. If we have not received payment or heard from you by then, the account will be referred to our branch manager.

If you have already paid, please send me the remittance details so I can match the payment. I'd be grateful for a reply by Thursday 12 November.

Kind regards,
Branch Administrator
Demo Decorating Contractors Ltd, Erith branch

letters.subject: Second reminder: invoices SI-30352 and SI-30380
letters.body:
Hello Aisha,

Invoice SI-30352 for £4,320.00 was due on 11 September 2026 and is now 55 days overdue. Invoice SI-30380 for £3,960.00 was due on 11 October 2026 and is 25 days overdue.

Could you let me know this week the date these will be paid? If there is a problem with either invoice, please tell me so we can put it right quickly. I'd be grateful for a reply by Thursday 12 November.

Kind regards,
Branch Administrator
Demo Decorating Contractors Ltd, Erith branch
